Name: Wizard's Magic Toddler
Author: kumijiang
Description:
[center]Added an AT version
新增了一个AT替代纹理版本

English is not good so all use the translator.
Because I like the wizard, I made his children, they have purple hair and red eyes, wearing a magic hat, have special standby action. 
Of course, you can change the color.
因为很喜欢法师，所以就制作了他的孩子，紫色的头发与红色的眼睛，带着魔法帽子，拥有特殊待机动作。
当然，你可以对它的颜色进行修改。[/center]
[center]It has its own magic hat, which is suitable for some smaller headwear, such as cat ears, mouse ears, and bows.
它们本身就有魔法帽。适用于较小的头饰，如猫耳朵、老鼠耳朵和蝴蝶结。[/center]


[center]Installation Guide[/center]
[center]Two installation methods are provided.
[u]CP format[/u]: download and unzip to the mod folder (recommended, more convenient)
[u]XNB format[/u]: Copy to the [u][b]Stardew Valley\Content\Characters[/b][/u] folder and replace the original file (depending on personal preference)
Just choose one    ヾ(^∀^)ﾉ

提供两种安装方法；
CP格式：下载并解压缩到mod文件夹（推荐，更方便）；
XNB格式：复制到Stardew Valley\Content\Characters文件夹并替换原始文件（取决于个人偏好）；
随便选一个。



Update version 1.1

Seeing someone needing it, I updated a version without a hat, and now you can choose a variety of hats.
看见有人需要，我更新了一个没有帽子的版本，现在你可以选择各种帽子了。

[u]CP format：[/u]
No file changes required,You need to download the [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to modify it in the game through game settings.
However, you need to leave the current room and enter again before this style can be refreshed.
无需更改文件，您需要下载[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]通用Mod配置菜单[/url]，通过游戏设置在游戏中进行修改。
不过你需要离开当前房间再进入，这个样式才会刷新

If you don't want to download other mods, please select the old version,It won't prompt for updates Please rest assured.
如果你不想下载其他mod，请选择CP旧版本，它不会提示更新请放心。


[u]XNB format[/u]: 
only needs to replace the corresponding file.
XNB格式只需要替换相应文件就可以。

[u]AT format：[/u]
More convenient!! You only need to download the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]AlternativeTextures[/url]﻿ to modify his texture with scissors in the game, and it can be used with other mods.
更加方便！！只需要下载AT模组，就能在游戏里通过剪刀修改他的纹理，并且和其他模组通用。[/center]
